items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: But he's one of the few people that I met later on, after 1939 that called me David.

ctx.x: Calls you John? Well, he calls me David and never calls me Panama. But he's one of the few people that I met later on, after 1939 that called me David. Everybody else calls me Panama, and how I got this name was my first day in the band with Roy, we were at rehearsal, and something happened - and I still couldn't read now; I was still playing by ear, but nobody knew it because like I say, drop that stick in a minute, and listen to what's going on while I'm looking for the stick, you know -- so anyway, something…
